qatre paani beh jayein. Sirf geela ho jana, tel ki tarah paani laga lena, ya ek
aadhi boond beh jana dhona nahi kehlata. Is se Wuzu ya Ghusl ada nahi hota.

Mas'alah 54: In mauqon par Wuzu karna Mustahab hai: sone ke liye, neend se
uthne ke baad, mayyat ko Ghusl dene ya uthane ke baad, humbistari se pehle, gussa
aane par, zubaan se Quran padhne ke liye, Hadith aur Deeni ilm padhne ya padhane
ke liye, Jumu'ah aur Eid ke ilawa doosre khutbon ke liye, Deeni kitabein chhoone
ke liye, Satr-e-Ghaleez chhoone ke baad, jhoot bolne, gaali dene ya behuda lafz
nikalne ke baad, kafir se badan chhoo jane par, Saleeb ya but chhoone par, Kodhi
ya safed daagh wale shakhs ko chhoone par, badboo wali baghal khujlane par,
Gheebat karne ke baad, zor se hansne par, laghw ashaar padhne par, oont ka gosht
khane par, aur kisi aurat ke badan se baghair kisi rukawat ke badan milne par.

hai. Ghusl ke teen juz hain. Agar in mein se ek mein bhi kami reh gayi to Ghusl nahi
hoga. Yun bhi keh sakte hain ke Ghusl mein teen Farz hain.

kaha jaye to jaiz nahi. Patte girne ya purane hone se paani badle to haraj nahi,
magar patte paani ko gaadha na kar dein.
